name: proportionPrompt
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art game environment, single landscape image 1536x1024, no panels.
Create a wide roadside checkpoint in a Pacific Northwest mountain valley, midday. Important: this is a WIDE ENVIRONMENT SHOT, not a close-up portrait. Believable human/vehicle architecture scale is the highest priority. The small toll booth occupies only x=630..1010, y=285..635 of this 1536x1024 canvas (about one quarter of image width and one third of its height), on the far shoulder of a wide asphalt road. Its window/counter is at y=485. An older feminine South Asian clerk with grey hair, plum blouse and cream apron bends her head down to inspect a blank cream permit, wearing a simple crooked paper crown. Clerk's HEAD must be SMALL, about 42 pixels wide and 50 pixels tall on the full canvas, her visible upper body about 115 pixels tall. Do NOT make her a giant or chibi. Human adult proportions, head about one seventh of hypothetical standing body height. The booth roof is 2.5 meters high, counter 1.1 meters high. A little kettle sits on counter. Plain wooden booth, low lintel, unlettered narrow sign. No tower or giant pillar behind booth.
Foreground roadway runs LEFT TO RIGHT, parallel to image plane, open uninterrupted asphalt from y=650 to bottom. Road far edge horizontal at y=640. The game will separately composite a 4.7 meter blue van at x=830..1500, wheel ground line y=825, height around 300 pixels including luggage. DO NOT DRAW ANY VAN OR VEHICLE. These coordinates are only composition guidance. Leave that foreground clear, including no bollards, barrier arm, people or obstacles. Distant booth official should have comparable or slightly smaller head than foreground van passengers, never larger. Keep lower-left foreground dark asphalt for a text overlay. Small patchy grass shoulder, medium trees to sides, distant layered blue mountains and blocky clouds. Environmental depth and consistent horizontal side-on camera, no extreme perspective.
Style: handcrafted crisp COARSE PIXEL ART with discrete squared pixel clusters, like a 384x256 retro adventure background enlarged 4x with nearest-neighbor edges. Restrained 32-color palette, dark pixel outlines, flat stepped 2-3 tone shadows. No photorealism, no painterly texture, no smooth gradients, no blur, no antialiasing. Avoid overly detailed tiny texture. No words or letters, no watermark. Absolutely NO religious symbols, crosses, religious jewelry, flags, emblems, or religious architecture.

name: crownPassedPrompt
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied pixel-art checkpoint background. Preserve EXACT canvas dimensions, framing, every environmental object, the booth position and size, small human character proportions and style, blank sign, road, mountains, trees, shadows. Change ONLY the little clerk's pose and crown: for the successful paid crossing, she has taken the simple paper crown off her head; it is caught at the lower window lintel above her, and she looks toward the road and gives a small open-handed wave. Remove the permit paper from her hand. Keep her head SMALL at its existing scale and her body entirely inside the same window, no close-up or enlargement. Same older feminine South Asian clerk, grey hair, plum blouse and cream apron. No vehicle or barrier added; those are separate game layers. No text. Absolutely no religious symbols, crosses, flags, emblems or jewelry. Crisp stepped pixel art, no blur or realism.
